info.name: OAN Grievance - Administration & Officer Management
info.description:
End-to-end administration workflows for **Grievance Admin** and **System Manager**.

### Core Capabilities Covered:
1. **Admin Authentication**: Sign in and refresh tokens.
2. **User Identity Onboarding (`/v1/admin/users`)**: Create user accounts, assign roles (`Grievance Officer`, `Grievance Review Officer`), retrieve user details, and issue temporary passwords.
3. **Officer Onboarding & Management (`/v1/officers`)**: Place officers on category desks as Nodal Officers (L1), Senior Officers (L2), Department Heads (L3), or Reviewers. Filter officers by level, department, status, category, and region; fetch status counts, manage leave/status, re-issue passwords, and inspect performance statistics.
4. **Category Desk Routing (`/v1/category-assignments`)**: Configure primary and secondary routing desks, SLA days, and auto-escalation.
5. **SLA Policies & Configuration (`/v1/sla-*`)**: Manage the global deferral ceiling and per-category SLA timers.
6. **Response Templates (`/v1/response-templates`)**: Manage pre-written investigation templates for officers.
7. **Notification Templates (`/v1/notification-templates`)**: Manage automated event notification templates and review placeholder dictionaries.
8. **Taxonomy & Master Data (`/v1/service-categories`, `/v1/grievance-types`)**: Manage categories and grievance types.

### Running in Newman / CI:
```bash
newman run postman/oan_grievance_admin_collection.json -e postman/local.postman_environment.json
```

request.description: Authenticates admin credentials (`usr` and `pwd`) and stores the returned Bearer `access_token` and `refresh_token` in collection and environment variables.
Exchanges the single-use refresh token for a fresh access and refresh token pair.
List user accounts holding a service role. Supports search, email, role, and enabled filters.
Create a user account in the auth service for a Senior Nodal Officer (L2). A temporary password is generated and returned once in the response.
Create a user account in the auth service for a Nodal Officer (L1) with role Grievance Officer.
Create a user account for a Department Head (L3) with roles Grievance Officer and Grievance Desk Head.
Create a user account for an internal Reviewer holding Grievance Review Officer (read-only oversight).
Account details, contact info, assigned roles, and app profiles of an onboarded user.
Update user account profile information (e.g. first_name, last_name, mobile).
List the service roles granted to a specific user account.
Generate a new temporary password for the user and revoke existing sessions.
List all roles within the service scope that can be granted by an administrator.

item.name: 1. Onboard Senior Nodal Officer (L2) on Desks

request.description: Places an existing user account onto category desks as a Senior Nodal Officer (L2). L2 officers act as supervisors and the first escalation rung for Nodal Officers.
Places an existing user account onto category desks as a Nodal Officer (L1). Requires level L1, department, service_categories, and an L2 supervisor (reports_to).
Creates a Department Head (L3) officer. An L3 is the department's final escalation rung who approves reassignments. Only one head handles a category in a department.
Places a Reviewer on a department's desks with read-only access limited to those desks. A Reviewer takes role='Reviewer', has no level or supervisor, and cases are never assigned to them.
List all officers. Paginated with page and page_size, returned newest first.
List Nodal Officers (L1) in a department and service category with Active status.
List Reviewer accounts. Note that Reviewers have no level and cannot be On Leave.
Returns Active, On Leave, and Inactive totals for dashboard and administration tabs.
Inspect an officer record: contact details, designation, level, supervisor, and category desk seats.
Update officer details: designation, phone number, and service category assignments.
Marks the officer as 'On Leave'. The auto-routing engine will temporarily bypass this officer.
Reactivates an officer returning from leave.
Reissues a temporary password to an officer. All existing sessions are terminated and the officer must change password on their next sign-in.
Officer KPI metrics: assigned cases, resolved count, avg resolution days, and resolution rate.
Deactivates an officer account and retires their desk assignment rows.
List active and configured category-to-department routing rules.
Assigns a category and department to primary (L1) and escalation (L2) officers with SLA days.
Retrieve detailed configuration of a single category desk assignment.
Update SLA days or toggle auto-escalation on a category desk assignment.
Soft-deactivates a category desk assignment (`active = 0`). Hard deletion is forbidden.
Read the global SLA policy (maximum deferral days, supervisor approval requirement).
Update global SLA limits across all categories.
List pre-written response templates available to officers.
Create a canned response template for grievance investigations.
Get the content and metadata of a response template.
Edit template title, body text, or category mapping.
Soft-deactivates the response template (`active = 0`).
List all configurable SMS, Email, and In-App notification event templates.
Returns available notification channels, events, and languages.
Dictionary of dynamic placeholders available for message bodies (e.g. {{ticket_number}}, {{submitter_name}}).
Fetch one notification template by its identifier.
Update subject or message body content for an event notification.
List service categories configured in the grievance catalog.
Add a new service category to the grievance registry.
List sub-types under a service category.
Add a specific grievance type under an active category.
